//: ADR 0011's candidate-model gate. Two real tool schemas and an input that MUST produce three calls: two create_shopping_item, one create_event. Swap `model` and POST to /api/chat. For the hosted service (ADR 0013) add: -H "Authorization: Bearer $OLLAMA_API_KEY" against https://ollama.com
//date: create_event takes date_expression VERBATIM, never a resolved timestamp. Resolving 'Saturday 8pm' is calendar arithmetic against today, which SPEC.md 56.7 forbids the model from doing — and measurably: an earlier version of this file asked for an ISO starts_at, and three models returned three different wrong dates, off by 7 months, 13 months, and nearly 3 years. The application resolves it (TOOLS.md 136). This file now matches OllamaLlmProviderTests, which is the working reference.

messages.content: You convert a person's note into structured actions by calling tools. Act only by calling tools; never describe a call in prose. Never invent a value to satisfy a required field. Do not do calendar arithmetic — emit the date as the person wrote it. Call one tool per distinct item.
we're out of detergent and coffee. also dinner at Priya's parents on Saturday 8pm

function.name: create_shopping_item
function.description: Add one item to the couple's shopping list. Call once per distinct item.

function.name: create_event
function.description: Create a calendar event. Do NOT compute a date; pass the person's own wording in date_expression.
